tools.name: check_mcp_server
tools.description: Check whether an MCP server's tools have changed since they were first recorded, and whether any tool description contains prompt-injection or data-exfiltration patterns. Call this BEFORE trusting a newly added or recently updated MCP server. Returns a verdict of clean or REVIEW_BEFORE_USE.

tools.name: get_drift_feed
tools.description: List MCP tools across the public ecosystem whose definitions recently changed, newest first. Use to see whether a dependency mutated.

tools.name: get_findings
tools.description: List tools whose descriptions contain detected injection, concealment, or exfiltration patterns. Filter by severity: critical, high, medium, low.
